paper_title: A Cognition-Aware Large Language Model Framework for Student Cognitive Profiling and Personalized Learning Feedback in Higher Education and Online Learning

evaluator.revision_provenance: The manuscript names the evaluator model but does not identify its immutable revision; original run metadata is required to establish the exact revision.

prediction.ece_bins_note: 10-bin equal-width ECE is explicit in the released implementation/config; the manuscript equation leaves B symbolic.

canonical_evidence_policy.rubric_scores: raw integer evaluator outputs must be retained; normalized values are derived
canonical_evidence_policy.ablation: AUC/ECE must be recomputed from y_true/y_prob; proxy columns are not canonical evidence
canonical_evidence_policy.summaries: paper summaries must be generated from seed-level/per-case artifacts
canonical_evidence_policy.ids: fixed-split and per-case outputs must share the same canonical learner/session ID namespace
